findings.title: Step-3 routing references are stale and omit G17
findings.why_it_matters: Progressive-disclosure files are executable instructions; they must route agents to the same checkpoint steps as the canonical sequence.
findings.what_is_wrong: method.md says the registry writes at step 8 instead of 10; implementation-reviewer.md routes approval to obsolete archive/commit steps 6/7; provider-adapters.md says commit is step 9 instead of 11; validation.md misroutes G15, G16, G17, and G27; resume-detection.md cites an unrelated sub-step 4 for idempotency. SKILL.md step 8 does not list required G17 at all.
findings.leverage_impact: A small cross-reference sweep restores one deterministic path through reviewer approval, gates, archive, registry, and commit.
findings.locality_impact: The canonical owner is SKILL.md; five progressive-disclosure readers have drifted from it.
findings.metric_signal: Seven definite stale or missing route clauses across six instruction files.
findings.why_weakens_submission: An agent loading the routed references can skip G17, write the registry at the wrong checkpoint, or believe archive/commit occurs before the canonical sequence permits it.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add G17 to Step 3 step 8 and update only the stale sub-step references to the canonical 6/8/9/10/11 sequence; refresh the existing Step-3 preregistration hash.
